about_the_game:
You are trapped in a silent swimming pool.

Everything is flooded, yet strangely calm.

Swim through the endless corridors and chambers of this submerged pool.

Watch closely, something is always just a little… wrong.

Anomalies distort the stillness.

When you notice one, turn back immediately.

If nothing is wrong, keep going forward.

Your only chance of escape lies in knowing the differences.

10 Feet Under is a short atmospheric psychological horror game about keen observation, growing tension, and the desperate search for escape. Explore winding corridors and submerged chambers where every detail matters. Spot the anomalies hidden in the stillness, decide when to press forward, and know when to turn back, your survival depends on it.

Features:

  • Explore: looping corridors, submerged pool, and abandoned chambers.

  • Spot anomalies: subtle distortions, unnatural objects, or impossible changes.

  • Decide carefully: if you see something wrong, turn back. If all looks normal, keep moving forward.

  • Endless tension: the further you go, the more reality bends around you.

  • Immersive sound & visuals designed to create a feeling of isolation and unease.

This is not a combat game — your survival depends entirely on your perception and awareness.

Play Time

15-60 minutes

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from around 2016 or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 or newer
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 7 from 2018 or later
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: A psychological horror walking simulator set in an endless flooded pool. Explore liminal corridors, notice subtle anomalies, and endure the growing tension as you search for an escape.
